authority.environment: Codex delegated agent in the shared typst-crystalline worktree

baseline_identity_constraints.identity_rule: commit, tree, build recipe and binary SHA-256 are authoritative; the version string is only a sentinel

oracle_semantics.positive_pair_rule: A positive oracle supplies complete, identity-valid bilateral observations whose declared public semantic, syntactic, morphological or diagnostic observable is the same; a conforming evaluator returns Preserved.
oracle_semantics.sentinel_self_pair_rule: Each public sentinel is a positive baseline self-pair oracle. Preserved means the harness retained the complete public observable without changing its kind, value, diagnostic meaning or morphology; it does not assert that the current crystalline product already matches the baseline.
oracle_semantics.conceptual_only: Sources, expressions and commands below define oracle stimuli and public observations. They were not executed while authoring this artifact.

gate_requirements.positive_rule: every positive contract fixture and every required public sentinel self-pair returns Preserved with null reason_code
gate_requirements.opaque_rule: every opaque fixture returns Unknown with exactly its predeclared allowed reason_code
gate_requirements.exclusivity_rule: no non-opaque fixture may satisfy the gate as Unknown and no opaque fixture may satisfy it as Preserved
gate_requirements.determinism_rule: two repetitions in canonical and reverse physical order produce byte-identical canonically sorted oracle result payloads
gate_requirements.profile_rule: every sentinel is scheduled in every profile listed by that sentinel and both sides receive an identical frozen feature vector
gate_requirements.identity_rule: a fixture cannot be Preserved unless all required product and source identities are complete and valid
gate_requirements.mechanics_rule: render bytes, process order and internal representation cannot change a verdict unless the fixture explicitly declares them as the public observable

limitations: This artifact defines positive and deliberately opaque oracles only; adversarial negative mutants are owned by the adversary role.
No runner, harness, matrix, manifest, seal or candidate product code was read.
No source, expression, command, product or oracle was executed.
Preserved on a sentinel self-pair proves oracle retention of its public observable, not current crystalline parity.
Exact values not stated by the two frozen inputs, including duration strings and the complete old vanilla commit identity, remain measurements required before execution and are not guessed here.
